Name: Veritas Ratio - the Harvey replacer mod
Author: AkurraV
Description:
[center][center][b][u]Update﻿
[/u][/b]Bug fixes for portraits not appearing correctly, added new troubleshooting.
There's a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29760]Russian translation[/url]﻿ for the mod's dialogue changes! Thank you [url=https://x.com/JdksjepfmaoIS]@JdksjepfmaoIS [/url]﻿from Twitter/X for translating! :DD
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

So you fell in love with the doctor himself but can't express your love for him more than getting e6 and s5 of him? Well now you can!﻿﻿

This mod will replace Harvey, the local doctor with HSR's own doctor, Veritas Ratio! All with personalized seasonal sprites and portraits, and a few other name changes in dialogues! Just download and you'd have him straight in your game!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Please read!

This mod is not [u]yet[/u][i] [/i]compatible with other file changing mods like Stardew valley Expanded and Ridgeside Valley! [/b]If used together may cause the Veritas mod to not work properly. Please wait for further updates when I make it compatible!

[b]Veritas' portraits are upscaled[/b], so you'd need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod to make sure he shows up correctly.

To get his portraits working, all you need to do is find the folder labeled [b]"Akurra's Veritas Portraits"[/b] in the [b]Veritas mod folder[/b], then drag it to [b]Portraiture > Portraits.[/b] Place it inside the[b] "Portraits" [/b]folder and you should be good!

To make sure his portrait shows up, you'd need to speak with him. if it still doesn't show up, please press "P" in your keyboard to switch portrait packs, or "O" to fix potential problems. It should work after! :)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][u]Troubleshooting!
[/u][/b][b][u]
[/u][/b]To those[b] unable to fix his portraits even after pressing keys[/b], please try to delete the "Akurra's Lighter Portraits" folder ([b]make sure to have another copy somewhere[/b], maybe keep one in the Lighter Mod folder! It won't be read by the system so it won't break the game, dw!), and then [b]copy it back to "Portraiture" > "Portraits"[/b] like where it was before! It should be refreshed and hopefully works!

Don't hesitate to message me by Twitter/X dms or Instagram if you encounter more problems! :D (Links on the bottom of the page.)

[b][size=5]If there are problems, please refer to the FAQ [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rJxDRpNEtrXEjIrWXAhJjVoZkATLG6ii/view?usp=sharing]here[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Due to my limitations, I have yet to be able to make Veritas into a standalone character himself, but I have been experimenting! I have a custom Aventurine NPC mod in the works just like that, with his own house, story and schedules, and hopefully he'll run around the game just fine like everyone else! :D
(Though everything is practically ready, I'm having trouble modding his heart events.. I have ideas, but coding it in is a little to much of a learning curve. if anyone could help with it, I'd be honored! But overall, I'll be trying it out myself.)

So far [b]only portrait, sprite and name changes are made[/b], no edits on gift tastes or dialogue. I might do them when i rework him into a standalone character someday!
